title: Enforce one end-to-end mailbox request deadline
outcome: Mailbox append and acknowledgement currently apply the five-second budget independently to FIFO writer admission, SQLite busy waiting, and duplicate dispatch finalization. A request can therefore consume multiple five-second stages even though the documentation reads as one bound. Thread one operation deadline through request admission, database acquisition, and finalization, and preserve retryable 503/idempotent recovery semantics.
acceptance: Append and acknowledgement share one deadline across all blocking stages; timeout errors remain typed retryable failures with accurate commit semantics; a cumulative-contention regression proves total waiting does not reset per stage; documentation states the end-to-end contract.
